blocks.text: Reina Filipinas Angelica Lopez was a vision of glamor in her sparkly gown at the 2026 Miss Grand International pageant’s welcome ceremony and press presentation in Thailand. But her raspy voice when she delivered her introduction revealed that she was not at her best physical condition. The event, held at the Grand Richmond Stylish Convention Hotel in Nonthaburi on Sept. 23, had all the 76 contestants parade in formal finery. Out to make a smashing impression, the ladies brought in the bling with heavily embellished pieces.
